attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: drupal_metadata_lookup

steps:
  - id: lookup_author_entity
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/node/author
      filter_field: title
      filter_value: "{{ article.author_name }}"
      method: GET
    output: author_result
    on_failure:
      op: flag_for_review
      params:
        article_id: "{{ article.id }}"
        reason: "Author not found – manual assignment required"
        flag_type: manual_author_assignment

  - id: lookup_category_term
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/taxonomy_term/category
      filter_field: name
      filter_value: "{{ article.category_name }}"
      method: GET
    output: category_result
    on_failure:
      op: abort
      params:
        reason: "Category taxonomy term not found for '{{ article.category_name }}'"

  - id: lookup_magazine_issue
    op: cms_jsonapi_query
    params:
      endpoint: /jsonapi/node/magazine_issue
      filter_field: field_issue_number
      filter_value: "{{ article.magazine_issue_number }}"
      method: GET
    output: issue_result
    on_failure:
      op: abort
      params:
        reason: "Magazine issue not found for issue number '{{ article.magazine_issue_number }}'"

  - id: validate_all_lookups
    op: assert_all_present
    params:
      required:
        - "{{ author_result.data.id }}"
        - "{{ category_result.data.id }}"
        - "{{ issue_result.data.id }}"
      error_message: "One or more metadata lookups failed – cannot proceed with article creation"
    depends_on:
      - lookup_author_entity
      - lookup_category_term
      - lookup_magazine_issue

  - id: merge_metadata
    op: merge_records
    params:
      fields:
        author_entity_id: "{{ author_result.data.id }}"
        author_name: "{{ author_result.data.attributes.title }}"
        category_term_uuid: "{{ category_result.data.id }}"
        category_name: "{{ category_result.data.attributes.name }}"
        magazine_issue_uuid: "{{ issue_result.data.id }}"
        magazine_issue_number: "{{ issue_result.data.attributes.field_issue_number }}"
        article_id: "{{ article.id }}"
    depends_on:
      - validate_all_lookups
    output: article_metadata_record
